updates.content:
Title: Some users may experience delays or failures receiving chat messages in Microsoft Teams desktop app

User impact: Users may experience delays or failures receiving chat messages in Microsoft Teams desktop app. 

More info: Affected users may experience delays of several minutes before messages appear in the desktop app. 

As a workaround, users may be able to use Microsoft Teams on the web to access messages without delay.

Current status: We’ve identified that a recent service update is causing some Microsoft Teams desktop registrations to be unexpectedly removed. When this occurs, the affected desktop client isn’t notified that it needs to re-register, preventing real-time message notifications from being delivered and causing messages to appear only after the client performs a periodic synchronization. We’re proceeding with reverting the responsible update to restore normal message delivery. 

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users receiving chat messages through the Microsoft Teams desktop app. 

Root cause: A recent service change is causing Microsoft Teams desktop client registrations to be removed without prompting the client to promptly re-register, preventing real-time message delivery and resulting in delays. 

Next update by: Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 12:00 PM UTC
